title: Two dead after children's party
subtitle: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit has identified the man who was fatally shot by police after a stabbing rampage in Oshawa, Ont., east of Toronto.
article: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit has identified the man who was fatally shot by police after a stabbing rampage in Oshawa, Ont., east of Toronto.
Gino Petralia, 47, died Saturday after officers responding to a 911 call found a woman, her husband and two children had been stabbed during a children's birthday party.
John Yoannou of the police Special Investigations Unit says when Petralia was located in an adjacent unit of the townhouse, a confrontation occurred and he was shot and killed by an officer.
Yoannou says the woman died of her injuries, while the three-year-old boy is in hospital in critical but stable condition and the five-year-old boy is reported as stable.
The husband is in hospital in Toronto in critical condition.
The couple's 11-year-old son, a 12-year-old cousin and another 13-year-old escaped unharmed and were taken to a police station in the company of a neighbour.
Yoannou says no police were injured and that the SIU, which has been interviewing neighbours, has not yet designated a "subject" officer as part of the investigation.
The SIU is a civilian police watchdog that probes police actions in cases where someone is killed or injured by an officer.
